note: Evidence matrix of the wiki. 'repo: self' entries are checked by CI (path and commit must exist). Entries about the private repositories are REQUIERE REVISION until the owner approves their publication; they carry commit ids and states only, never internal paths, identities or unpublished weaknesses.

claim.es: El canal toma reglas de dos repositorios (Neo23x0/signature-base y Yara-Rules/rules) y usa un tercero, VirusTotal/yara-x, solo como motor de evaluación (kind: engine), no como proveedor de reglas.
claim.en: The channel takes rules from two repositories (Neo23x0/signature-base and Yara-Rules/rules) and lists a third, VirusTotal/yara-x, only as an evaluation engine (kind: engine), not as a rule provider.

claim.es: Hay tres releases de reglas publicadas; la última es rules-20261021-39541028283.
claim.en: Three rule releases are published; the latest is rules-20261021-39541028283.

entries.validation: workflow read; signature verified by scripts/verify_public_release.py on the latest release

claim.es: Cada release se firma con Sigstore sin clave almacenada, desde el workflow publish.yml, tras una aprobación humana.
claim.en: Each release is signed with Sigstore with no stored key, from the publish.yml workflow, after a human approval.

claim.es: Cada publicación se registra en un registro de transparencia (árbol Merkle) con checkpoints firmados que cualquiera puede verificar.
claim.en: Every publication is recorded in a transparency log (Merkle tree) with signed checkpoints anyone can verify.

claim.en: The private quarantine panel is deployed and in use, in its version before the persistent-withdrawal and source-proposal features.

claim.en: Decision memory and persistent withdrawals are implemented and merged to main, but not deployed, and their database migration is not applied.

claim.en: The process to propose and admit new rule sources is implemented in main but not deployed; no new source has been added.

claim.en: The three-provider historical archive (R2, B2, Scaleway) has its tools and design, but is NOT operational: no restoration from any real provider has been tested yet.

claim.es: MacGuard Installer Auditor (GUI, CLI y TUI sobre un núcleo común, CLI macguard-audit 0.2.0) instala reglas del canal solo si pasan firma Sigstore, manifiesto, SHA-256, conjunto exacto de ficheros, pruebas Merkle y antirretroceso; está sin firmar ni notarizar.
claim.en: MacGuard Installer Auditor (GUI, CLI and TUI over one core, CLI macguard-audit 0.2.0) installs channel rules only if they pass the Sigstore signature, manifest, SHA-256, exact file set, Merkle proofs and anti-rollback; it is neither signed nor notarized.

entries.source: scripts/macguard_smoke.py and the CI job app-compat
entries.validation: absence of an end-to-end test found by survey

claim.es: No existe una prueba de rendimiento de extremo a extremo de la app Installer Auditor con el canal real; la prueba de humo existente copia las reglas directamente sin pasar la verificación del canal. Esa prueba está PLANIFICADA.
claim.en: There is no end-to-end performance test of the Installer Auditor app with the live channel; the existing smoke test copies the rules in directly and skips the channel verification. That test is PLANNED.

entries.source: GitLab security-mac/macusb-guard, branch ai/v1-release-integration, HEAD 78f7d37 (2026-09-30); tag v1.0.0-rc1

claim.es: MacUSBGuard está en validación hacia una V1: su documentación lo describe como vista previa de desarrollo en modo solo observación; existe un tag v1.0.0-rc1 que no es ancestro de la rama actual. No importa otras aplicaciones MacGuard.
claim.en: MacUSBGuard is in validation towards a V1: its documentation describes it as a development preview in observe-only mode; a v1.0.0-rc1 tag exists that is not an ancestor of the current branch. It does not import other MacGuard applications.

claim.es: Las comprobaciones de hardware de MacUSBGuard (HID y almacenamiento) siguen sin verificar porque falta la autorización de Apple para Endpoint Security.
claim.en: MacUSBGuard hardware checks (HID and storage) remain unverified because Apple's Endpoint Security entitlement is missing.

claim.es: MacFirewallGuard está en desarrollo: tiene motor de políticas, modelo de flujos y procesos y una app SwiftUI, pero todavía NO puede bloquear conexiones porque falta la autorización de Apple para Network Extension.
claim.en: MacFirewallGuard is in development: it has a policy engine, a flow and process model and a SwiftUI app, but it cannot block connections yet because Apple's Network Extension entitlement is missing.

entries.source: GitLab security-mac/macfirewall-guard, roadmap and release documents at 052007e

claim.es: Fases de MacFirewallGuard: F1-A, F1-B y GUI-V1 cerradas; F2-A parcial; F2-NIM integrada. Bloqueos documentados: la autorización de Apple y que MacCoreGuard aún no existe como servicio. MacFirewallGuard tiene un cliente de MacCoreGuard probado solo contra un simulacro.
claim.en: MacFirewallGuard phases: F1-A, F1-B and GUI-V1 closed; F2-A partial; F2-NIM merged. Documented blockers: Apple's entitlement and the fact that MacCoreGuard does not yet exist as a service. MacFirewallGuard has a MacCoreGuard client tested only against a mock.

claim.es: MacProcessGuard es un concepto: el README de MacFirewallGuard afirma que todavía no existe; no hay repositorio, código ni especificación propia.
claim.en: MacProcessGuard is a concept: the MacFirewallGuard README states it does not exist yet; there is no repository, code or specification of its own.

entries.source: GitLab security-mac/maccore-guard, branch candidate/macfirewallguard-session-reference, one commit b0b0f07 (2026-10-09)
entries.validation: commit count and message read; static survey of the sources

claim.es: MacCoreGuard es un prototipo de un solo commit: implementa un protocolo y una capa criptográfica (cadena de hashes SHA-256 y árbol Merkle RFC 9162 con pruebas de inclusión y consistencia); registro, firma e ingesta son marcadores de posición.
claim.en: MacCoreGuard is a one-commit prototype: it implements a protocol and a cryptography layer (SHA-256 hash chain and an RFC 9162 Merkle tree with inclusion and consistency proofs); ledger, signing and ingest are placeholders.

claim.es: MacGuardDesignKit es una biblioteca SwiftUI sin dependencias externas (tags v0.1.0 a v0.3.1); su 1.0 exige dos productos que la usen y cinco decisiones de diseño pendientes.
claim.en: MacGuardDesignKit is a SwiftUI library with no external dependencies (tags v0.1.0 to v0.3.1); its 1.0 needs two consuming products and five pending design decisions.
